scripts.build: prisma generate && next build && pnpm run bundle:server
scripts.bundle:server: esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server.mjs --packages=external --alias:@=./src --banner:js="import { createRequire as __createRequire } from 'module'; const require = __createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.import:bundle: esbuild prisma/import-dndtools.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=import-dndtools.mjs --packages=external --alias:@=./src --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
